text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Robert Ruggiero has resigned from the Property Standards Committee effective January 5, 2024. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are planning to lead a recruitment and selection process to fill the vacant position in the coming months.
The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Received the letter (January 10, 2024) from the Manager, Public Appointments.
